title: MEIKO — Strength From Kindness〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: The Phoenix in the Distant Sky

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hm? What's going on? Why are you all gathered here?

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Rin and Len were having a footrace, but they finished at the same time...

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: We couldn't tell who actually finished first...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's why I'm telling you all, Rin definitely finished faster than I did...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Not true!
Len, you totally beat me by a nose!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's odd. They're both saying that the other person finished first... Not many people argue for their opponent.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Well, in any case...
I'll watch, so why don't you two have a remat—

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Nene, welcome! Are you here by yourself?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I was hoping to go for a run here.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. To increase your stamina...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, but today's practice went on for longer than I was expecting. It's gotten dark already...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So I was hoping that I could do my running here to be on the safe side. Mind if I do for a bit...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's fine, of course! We were just about to have a footrace of our own!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup! Nene, let's run it together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks. I think I'll join you, then.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You'll start at the teacups, run to the tent over there, turn around and come back. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm not losing this time, Len.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What?! You're all going with them?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I was planning on waiting here, but...
Hehe. In that case, I'll join you all♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This is rough... Right after practice too...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Hmm... It wasn't meant to be a very long course, but they all look exhausted...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Nene's coming here right after practicing, while Rin and Len just did a run a second ago.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (If any of them start to look like they're in trouble, maybe I should stop the...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You really took a tumble there. Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah... I'm... Ow!
My leg... I think it's coming undone...

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line:
*Sob*
But I wanna keep running with everyone...

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line:
Don't worry! Here, I'll help carry you!
We can run until the end together like this!

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Yay! We all finished at the same time!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... We really did it, Rin, Len.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Working together like that was a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. We even stopped caring about who actually finished first or whatever.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, does this mean you two have made up?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks for running with me, everyone. I might've given up partway through if you guys weren't there with me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks for running with us, Plushies!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thank you too, MEIKO.
I feel better about myself now after actually finishing that run.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That's wonderful to hear!
Putting on stamina takes a lot of mental strength, so it's important to do it one step at a time!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, I'll keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I just suggested that footrace off the top of my head, but it all worked out in the end.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Must be because I'm always such a good girl♪)
